analysis.name: Paintable Surface Identification
analysis.method: Stage 1 patch-based geometric classification with advanced geometry integration
analysis.description: Identifies geometrically suitable planar and curved surface candidates for spray painting.
analysis.limitations: A paintable candidate is not proof of actual spray accessibility or robot reachability. Visibility, occlusion, spray gun orientation, standoff distance, collision clearance and fixture interference must be evaluated later.

configuration.curved_surface_policy: Curved patches are not rejected based on global normal coherence.
configuration.internal_cylindrical_surface_policy: Internal cylindrical surface candidates require review and are not automatically excluded.

interpretation.reason: Advanced geometry features are retained for process review. Automatic exclusion requires explicit painting process rules.
